Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Dehydroacetic acid is a substituted pyran-dione compound with antimicrobial activity. Its food role is preservative use in specified applications. FDA describes a restricted application involving cut or peeled squash. That permission and its conditions concern this compound specifically, rather than all related dehydroacetate preparations.
